40840472.clinical_problem: Automatically segmenting spinal lesions across multiple adolescent spinal disorders on X-ray to support computer-aided diagnosis
40840472.patient_population: Self-constructed large-scale multi-disease adolescent spinal X-ray dataset
40840472.model_description: DCE-UNet, a hybrid CNN-Transformer segmentation network, automatically segments lesion regions across multiple adolescent spinal disorders in X-ray images.

40843405.clinical_problem: Predicting need for surgical intervention (pyeloplasty) in antenatal hydronephrosis and pelviureteric junction obstruction using imaging-based scoring systems
40843405.patient_population: Patients with antenatal hydronephrosis or confirmed pelviureteric junction obstruction across nine reviewed predictive tools
40843405.model_description: Comprehensive review of nine imaging-based predictive tools/scoring systems (one using machine learning) for stratifying risk of needing surgical intervention in antenatal hydronephrosis and pelviureteric junction obstruction.

40848095.clinical_problem: Estimating pediatric age from chest radiographs as a complement to bone age assessment, to help screen for abnormal growth and development
40848095.patient_population: 128,008 pediatric chest X-rays from two tertiary hospitals in Shanghai
40848095.model_description: A ResNet-based deep neural network with a Coordinate Attention mechanism predicts pediatric age directly from chest radiographs, using heatmap visualization to identify the anatomic regions (spine, mediastinum, heart) driving the prediction.
40848095.headline_result: MAE 5.86 (M)/5.80 (F) months internal; 7.40/7.29 months external; Spearman r>0.98
40848095.study_design: retrospective model development with internal and external validation

40848140.clinical_problem: Detecting upper extremity fractures in children presenting to the emergency department
40848140.model_description: The commercial AI software BoneView analyzes radiographs of the pediatric upper extremity to detect fractures, compared against reference readings by two pediatric radiologists.
40848140.headline_result: sensitivity 89%, specificity 91% overall; wrist sens 96%/spec 94%, elbow sens 87%/spec 65%

40849234.clinical_problem: Predicting adverse clinical outcomes (major hemorrhage, hysterectomy) in placenta accreta spectrum using MRI morphological indicators and clinical features
40849234.patient_population: 125 clinically confirmed PAS patients from two centers
40849234.model_description: Interpretable machine learning classifiers (AdaBoost, TabPFN, CatBoost) combine MRI morphological indicators with clinical features to predict adverse outcomes in placenta accreta spectrum, deployed as an online SHAP-explained risk calculator.
40849234.study_design: retrospective multicenter model development and external validation

40855255.clinical_problem: Classifying pediatric thoracic diseases (and cardiovascular disease) from chest imaging using an efficient self-supervised pretraining method
40855255.model_description: Snap-MAE, a self-supervised masked-autoencoder pretraining method using snapshot ensemble learning, is fine-tuned for multi-label pediatric thoracic disease classification (among other medical imaging tasks) and compared against standard MAE, ViT-S, and ResNet-34 baselines.

40868328.clinical_problem: Evaluating cardiac hemodynamic parameters via echocardiography to diagnose hemorrhagic complications related to patent ductus arteriosus in preterm infants
40868328.model_description: YOLO-based deep learning models automatically detect and measure five key cardiac parameters (LVET, LVIDd, LVIDs, HES, RR interval) from echocardiographic waveforms to assess cardiac function and screen for PDA-related hemorrhagic complications in preterm infants.

40886727.clinical_problem: Identifying brain connectivity patterns and psychological resilience associated with non-suicidal self-injury in adolescents
40886727.model_description: Support vector machine analysis of whole-brain resting-state fMRI connectivity identifies neural correlates of non-suicidal self-injury in adolescents, examining psychological resilience as a mediating factor.

40890480.clinical_problem: Assessing fetal lung volumes and function (via T2* relaxometry) in congenital diaphragmatic hernia to help predict prognosis (survival)
40890480.patient_population: 33 control fetuses and 12 fetuses with congenital diaphragmatic hernia
40890480.model_description: A pre-trained 3D deep-learning pipeline segments fetal lungs on motion-corrected MRI to quantify lung volume and T2* relaxometry values, assessed as potential prognostic biomarkers for survival in congenital diaphragmatic hernia.
40890480.headline_result: CDH lung volumes and T2* significantly lower in non-survivors vs controls (p<0.05 to p<0.001)

40894124.clinical_problem: Distinguishing familial from non-familial ADHD in children using multimodal brain MRI and deep learning
40894124.model_description: An auto-encoder-based deep learning pipeline with feature selection classifies familial versus non-familial ADHD and controls using T1-weighted and diffusion-weighted MRI cortical and white-matter metrics.
40894124.headline_result: AUC 0.67 (ADHD-F vs controls), 0.70 (ADHD-NF vs controls), 0.67 (ADHD-F vs ADHD-NF)

40906888.exclusion_reason: conference workshop summary covering multiple body MRI topics broadly; not specific to pediatric radiology AI (AI mentioned as one of several general session topics).

40909792.clinical_problem: Identifying neuroanatomical correlates of impulsivity in youth using structural MRI
40909792.patient_population: 9,099 youth at baseline, 6,432 at 2-year follow-up, from the Adolescent Brain Cognitive Development (ABCD) Study
40909792.model_description: Multivariate brain-based predictive models relate neuroanatomical features (cortical thickness, surface area, gray matter volume) from structural MRI to individual differences in impulsivity across behavioral scales in youth from the ABCD Study.

40920305.clinical_problem: Classifying standard fetal ultrasound planes to support prenatal anomaly screening
40920305.model_description: FetalMLOps, a ten-step MLOps framework, operationalizes machine learning models for standard fetal ultrasound plane classification, covering data curation, model development, deployment via a RESTful API, explainability, and monitoring for clinical integration.

40930425.clinical_problem: Modeling brain functional dynamics and connectivity disruption in children with leukemia using a biophysically constrained neural network derived from multimodal MRI
40930425.patient_population: 20 healthy controls and 19 children with leukemia
40930425.model_description: BRAINN, an analog electrical neural-network model constrained by biophysical parameters estimated from multimodal MRI (diffusion tractography and functional connectivity), simulates brain dynamics and connectivity to assess disruption before and during leukemia treatment in children.
40930425.dataset_size: 39 participants (20 healthy controls, 19 children with leukemia)

40933788.clinical_problem: Using artificial intelligence, including neuroimaging-based approaches, for early detection and individualized evaluation of autism spectrum disorder in children
40933788.patient_population: Children with autism spectrum disorder (narrative review of about 100 articles, 2010-2024)
40933788.model_description: Narrative review of AI applications (including machine learning on neuroimaging, genetics, behavioral, and electronic medical record data) for early detection, diagnosis, and individualized treatment planning in autism spectrum disorder.

40945816.clinical_problem: Characterizing abnormal brain developmental trajectories (brain age) in early-onset schizophrenia using multimodal MRI and machine learning
40945816.patient_population: 80 antipsychotic-naive first-episode early-onset schizophrenia patients and 91 typically developing controls
40945816.model_description: Machine learning brain-age estimation models trained on structural, diffusion, and functional MRI connectome features predict individual brain age; the gap between predicted and chronological brain age is compared between early-onset schizophrenia patients and typically developing controls.
40945816.headline_result: increased brain age gap in EOS vs TD using structural/morphometric connectome features, correlated with symptom severity

40946680.clinical_problem: Classifying sex from pediatric hand radiographs for forensic and anthropological applications
40946680.patient_population: RSNA Pediatric Bone Age dataset (hand X-ray images from pediatric patients)
40946680.model_description: Zero-shot Segment Anything Model (SAM) segments pediatric hand radiographs, and deep learning ensemble models classify sex from the segmented hand bone structure and silhouette, with attention-map explainability.
40946680.study_design: retrospective model development using a public dataset

40947369.exclusion_reason: general review of PET-CT in sarcoma management across all ages; pediatric cases and AI mentioned only briefly, not the review's focus.

40948509.clinical_problem: Externally validating machine learning models for diagnosing, staging severity, and guiding management of pediatric appendicitis
40948509.patient_population: 430 patients (Regensburg, Germany) for model development; 301 patients (Dusseldorf, Germany) for external validation
40948509.model_description: Machine learning models combining demographic, clinical, scoring, laboratory, and ultrasound parameters predict the diagnosis, severity, and management (e.g., surgery) of pediatric appendicitis, externally validated across two independent European hospital cohorts.
